getAnimationInstance.zh-CN: 每创建一次动画（包括每次重新加载）调用一次的回调，参数为当前动画的 AnimationItem。
getAnimationInstance.en-US: Called once per animation created, including every reload, with the AnimationItem of the animation.

getLottie.zh-CN: lottie-web 加载完成后，每次挂载调用一次的回调，参数为全局 Lottie。
getLottie.en-US: Called once per mount after lottie-web has loaded, with the global Lottie.

height.en-US: Container height, with a unit such as 300px.

params.zh-CN: 传给 lottie-web loadAnimation 的参数。内容变化时重新加载（原地修改 `$state` 也会）；交给 lottie-web 前会做快照，较大的动画数据用 `$state.raw` 持有。
params.en-US: Options passed to lottie-web's loadAnimation. It reloads when the content changes (mutating a `$state` in place counts too); a snapshot is taken before it reaches lottie-web, and large animation data is best held in `$state.raw`.

width.en-US: Container width, with a unit such as 300px.
